## 🎙️ OmniVoice AI Pull Request

### Description
Brief summary of the changes made and the motivation/context behind them.

### Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement / optimization
- [ ] 🎨 UI/UX styling enhancement
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Tests / CI pipeline update

### How Has This Been Tested?
Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes:
- [ ] Ran automated test suite (`npm test`) -> All 7/7 tests passed
- [ ] Manual audio pipeline check (Outbound / Inbound)
- [ ] Browser cross-compatibility check (Chrome / Edge / Brave)

### Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or console errors
